label: 主要用途
Primary uses
value: 穿行、停留、文化参观、活动

label: 所在城市人口
City population
scope: 2025-12-31；Comune di Siena全市镇注册常住人口，不是省级人口。
31 Dec 2025; municipal registered residents, not the province.

label: 公布广场面积
Published plaza area
scope: Sepe等2021论文所列广场表面积；此处四舍五入显示，不由图像推算。
Square surface area listed in Sepe et al. 2021; display rounded, not measured from an image.

label: 公布活动容量
Published event capacity
scope: 2026 Palio中央站立区，赛事安保方说明；不含所有外围看台，也不是平日固定上限。
2026 Palio central standing area, per event security provider; not all grandstands or a permanent ordinary-day limit.
metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

label: 广场年到访量
Annual square visitation
scope: 未取得广场级完整年度统计；不使用全市住宿人次替代。
No complete square-level annual count found; city accommodation nights are excluded.

label: 常规Palio场次
Regular Palio races
scope: 常规日期7月2日与8月16日，可因天气延期；不是广场全部年度活动数。
Regular dates: 2 July and 16 August; weather postponements possible. Not the total square event count.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: 壳形坡面与低侧市政宫共同形成观看和停留方向。
Shell-shaped ground and the low-side palace establish direction for viewing and staying.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 火车与公交衔接历史中心，最终步行进入广场。
Rail and buses connect to the historic centre, with a final pedestrian approach.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: 坡地与喷泉融入空间体验；核心为硬质铺装，而非连续绿地。
Slope and fountain shape experience; the core is paved rather than continuous planted land.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 餐饮与外摆沿边缘展开，中心仍承担免费停留与公共活动。
Dining and terraces occupy edges while the centre supports informal stay and civic events.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: 夏季需避晒，凉季有雨；原LaMMA基准年降雨785.7 mm（1961—1990），不是当前年度。
Summer sun and cool-season rain matter; LaMMA’s baseline annual rainfall is 785.7 mm (1961–1990), not a current-year total.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类并存，Palio是特定时段的转换。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist, with Palio as a timed transformation.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 平日坐卧和穿行；Palio常规每年2场，赛事时配置赛道、围栏和受控入口。
Ordinary sitting and passage change to track, barriers and controlled entries for the two regular annual Palio races.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: 2026安保执行记录为中央区约15,000人；不是全广场人数，也没有广场年量。
2026 provider account: approximately 15,000 in the centre; not a whole-square total. Annual square count unavailable.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 数字交通信息与赛事流量管理为主；未证实核心广场有常设大型数字艺术屏。
Digital transit information and event-flow management are documented; no permanent large digital-art screen in the core is established.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: Contrade组织和Palio体现社区作用，同时是世界性游客目的地。
Contrade and Palio express community roles alongside international tourism.

title: 可坐卧的坡地
An inhabitable slope
text: 地面本身就参与停留与观看，而不只是一片铺装。
Ground itself supports staying and viewing rather than acting only as paving.

title: 街巷收束与展开
Compression and release
text: 狭窄街巷在进入广场时突然开敞，增强整体空间辨识。
Narrow lanes release into the square, strengthening its spatial identity.

title: 社区仪式的延续
Continuity of civic ritual
text: Palio将地方社区和公共地面持续联系起来。
Palio keeps local communities connected to civic ground.

title: Piazza del Campo
Piazza del Campo
lede: 把坡地变成城市客厅：壳形地面、街巷入口与市政宫共同形成向心的公共空间。
A slope becomes a civic living room: shell-shaped ground, lane entrances and the civic palace create an inward focus.

label: Sepe等：广场面积
Sepe et al.: published square area

title: 位置：历史街巷汇聚的城市中心
Location: the civic focus of converging lanes
lede: 市镇常住人口53,588人（2025年末）；公共交通到达历史中心外围，再步行进入广场。
53,588 municipal residents at end-2025; transit reaches the edges of the historic centre, followed by walking.

title: 公共交通
Public transport
text: 城外火车站与Piazza Gramsci等节点由公交连接。
Buses connect the railway station outside the walls with nodes such as Piazza Gramsci.

title: 最后一段步行
The final walk
text: 广场本体不由机动车贯穿，需穿过历史街巷到达。
Vehicles do not run through the square; the final approach uses historic lanes.

title: 城市角色
Civic role
text: 市政、Contrade社区仪式与旅游共享同一中心。
Municipal life, Contrade community ritual and tourism share the same centre.

title: 历史：公共地面与共同规则
History: civic ground and shared rules
lede: 广场的整体性既来自地形，也来自跨建筑的市政建设与管理。
Its coherence comes from terrain as well as municipal building and management rules.

title: 地面
Ground
text: 砖铺地与放射石带加强壳形地面的统一性。
Brick paving and radial stone bands reinforce the unity of the shell-like ground.

title: 边界
Edges
text: 市政宫与外围建筑共同围合，不依赖各楼完全等高。
Civic palace and surrounding buildings provide enclosure without every building being equal in height.

title: 公共传统
Civic tradition
text: Contrade与Palio使广场长期承担社区表达，而非只有观光用途。
Contrade and Palio sustain community expression beyond sightseeing.

title: 同一比例，看三种城市肌理
One scale, three urban fabrics
lede: Campo是密集历史街区中的壳形空场；相同图幅让它与圣马可和墨尔本直接比较。
Campo is a shell-shaped opening in dense fabric; the common frame makes direct visual comparison possible.

text: 三案均为600 × 600米，北向上、横纵同尺度；矢量图按300毫米宽输出时为1:2500。网页缩放请读图形比例尺。
All three frames cover 600 × 600 m, north up with identical axis scale. Native SVG at 300 mm width is 1:2500; use the graphic bar on screens.

title: 平面：空间如何组织
Plan: how the place is organised
lede: 用原研究平面阅读街巷入口与公共地面的相互关系。
Use the published plan to read entrances and civic ground together.

text: 弧形边缘与多处街巷入口让地面成为一个明确的城市房间。Nolli图中的公共地面与建筑内部应按原图的研究定义阅读。
Curved edges and multiple lane entrances make a legible civic room. Public ground and interiors in the Nolli drawing follow the author’s research definitions.

title: 剖面：坡面朝市政宫汇聚
Section: the ground converges toward the palace
lede: 横、纵剖面保留原始比例尺，坡地如何汇聚一目了然。
Cross and longitudinal sections retain their original bar, making the slope legible.

text: 原研究剖面清楚显示：地面并非水平，市政宫位于视觉低侧。坡面把观看、坐卧和城市仪式组织在同一场地中。
The published section shows a non-level ground and the palace at the visual low side. The slope brings viewing, informal sitting and civic ritual into one space.

title: 连接：抵达、穿行与停留
Connections: arrival, passage and staying
lede: 狭窄入口突然打开为宽阔坡面，是Campo最鲜明的步行体验。
Narrow entrances suddenly opening to the broad slope define Campo’s walking experience.

title: 抵达
Arrival
text: 公共交通到达外围节点，再从街巷进入。
Transit arrives at peripheral nodes, followed by lanes.

title: 穿行
Passage
text: 入口压缩后迅速展开，广场兼有通行与目的地属性。
Compressed entrances open rapidly; the square is both route and destination.

title: 停留
Staying
text: 坡面和边缘让坐、看与交谈有不同位置可选。
Slope and edges provide choices for sitting, viewing and conversation.
这是形态解读；不把出版研究图或照片包装成本网站的空间句法测算。
This is a spatial reading; published drawings and photos are not represented as syntax calculations by this site.

label: 原研究：入口与空间体验
Published study: entrances and spatial experience

title: 边界：建筑与公共地面
Edges: buildings meet civic ground
lede: 连续街墙提供整体围合，市政宫与塔楼提供重点；统一不等于完全相同。
Continuous fronts provide enclosure; palace and tower provide focus. Coherence does not require uniformity.

text: 边界包含不同材料、开间与年代的建筑。整体空间秩序来自连续界面与共同地面，不是把每栋建筑画成同一种立面。
Edges include different materials, bays and periods. Continuous fronts and shared ground create coherence, not identical individual facades.

title: 环境：景观、气候与科技
Environment: landscape, climate and technology
lede: 内陆丘陵气候、开敞砖地与建筑阴影决定使用条件；树木不是核心广场的主要围合元素。
Inland hill climate, exposed brick ground and building shade shape use; trees are not the core square’s enclosing device.

title: 景观
Landscape
text: 坡地和Fonte Gaia提供地形与水的体验，核心不是绿地公园。
Slope and Fonte Gaia provide terrain and water experiences; the core is not a planted park.

title: 天气与气候
Weather and climate
text: 夏季较热，冬季较凉，秋季降雨较多。LaMMA的1961—1990基准年降雨785.7 mm；建筑阴影提供局部缓冲，雨会影响赛事。
Hotter summers, cooler winters and wetter autumns. LaMMA baseline rainfall is 785.7 mm/year (1961–1990); building shade offers local relief and rain affects racing.

title: 科技
Technology
text: 以信息、交通和赛事安全管理为主，不把历史空间误写成数字展示广场。
Information, transit and event management matter more than digital spectacle.

title: 平日：人们怎样使用这里
Ordinary days: how people use the place
lede: 普通日的坡面是穿行、短坐、交谈与观看建筑的共同地面。
On ordinary days, the slope supports passage, short stays, conversation and views of architecture.

text: 普通日可以慢行、坐卧与观看；餐饮消费集中在边缘。这里的开放并不意味着所有位置都适合所有身体条件。
Ordinary days allow walking, sitting and viewing, with dining at the edges. Openness does not make every position equally accessible.

title: 节假日与活动：地面的另一种状态
Holidays and events: the ground transforms
lede: Palio不是普通周末的放大版：赛道、围栏、看台和入口控制改变了整个使用方式。
Palio is not simply a busier weekend: track, barriers, grandstands and controlled entries change how the ground works.

rows: 主要功能
Main functions

Passage, sitting, conversation, visits and dining

Palio and Contrade ritual

Spatial layout

Track, central standing area and perimeter stands

Access & management

Lane access; not universal step-free access

Depends on events, weather and management

2026 provider account: about 15,000 centrally

Quantitative record
未有同口径日均统计

2 regular Palio races/year, not all square events

title: 数字：规模、容量与使用强度
Numbers: scale, capacity and use
lede: 人口按市镇／LGA范围；容量是特定活动或场地布置口径；年到访量单独列出。
Population uses municipal/LGA boundaries; capacity is event- or layout-specific; annual visitation is listed separately.

text: 活动容量不是全年访客量，也不是随时允许进入的人数。三案未公开同口径的平日／节假日人流序列，因此不伪造倍数关系。
Event capacity is neither annual visitation nor a constant admission allowance. Matched ordinary-day/holiday footfall series are unavailable, so no multiplier is invented.

title: 统一评价①：空间与环境
Aligned assessment 1: space and environment
lede: 以下五项在三个案例中采用完全相同的名称、顺序和判断口径。
The same five dimensions, in the same order and with the same interpretation, apply to all three cases.

title: 统一评价②：使用与公共性
Aligned assessment 2: use and publicness
lede: 区分功能、时段、规模、科技与服务对象；BOTH表示社区与游客均被服务，不代表两者人数相等。
Separate programme, timing, scale, technology and users. BOTH means both communities and visitors are served, not equal headcounts.

title: 最突出的三个特点
Three defining qualities
lede: 最鲜明的价值在于坡地、街巷与社区仪式的共同作用，而不只是壳形轮廓。
Its defining value lies in slope, lanes and civic ritual acting together, beyond the shell-shaped outline.

title: 可坐卧的坡地
An inhabitable slope
text: 地面本身就参与停留与观看，而不只是一片铺装。
Ground itself supports staying and viewing rather than acting only as paving.

title: 街巷收束与展开
Compression and release
text: 狭窄街巷在进入广场时突然开敞，增强整体空间辨识。
Narrow lanes release into the square, strengthening its spatial identity.

title: 社区仪式的延续
Continuity of civic ritual
text: Palio将地方社区和公共地面持续联系起来。
Palio keeps local communities connected to civic ground.
主要限制：坡地不等于普遍无障碍，夏季遮阴有限，赛事时自由通行受到明显限制。
Principal limitations: slope is not universal accessibility, summer shade is limited, and events restrict free passage.

Compare the full three-case assessment matrix

title: 资料与证据边界
Sources and evidence limits
lede: 正文保留空间判断；完整出处、统计口径与方法集中在这里。
The main pages focus on spatial findings; complete provenance, statistical definitions and methods are collected here.

text: 保留来源年份、统计范围与空值。01的2018活动限额、03的2026赛事站立区和04的现行场租容量不可直接理解为同一时点的全广场安全上限。
Year, boundary and missing values are retained. The 2018 event cap in 01, 2026 standing area in 03 and current venue listing in 04 are not a single-date set of universal safety limits.
Google Maps为三案统一位置地图。建筑图底统一图幅和米制投影；01／03使用Overture 2026-10-21资料，经TerraLab提取，04保留墨尔本官方2020地面层资料。年代与轮廓定义不同；计算结果用于描述形态，不作为公共空间质量排名。

Google Maps is the common location map. Figure-ground uses an identical metric frame: 01/03 use Overture 2026-10-21 through TerraLab; 04 retains official Melbourne 2020 ground/podium data. Dates and footprint definitions differ; results describe form rather than rank civic quality.

intro_lede: 把坡地变成城市客厅：壳形地面、街巷入口与市政宫共同形成向心的公共空间。
A slope becomes a civic living room: shell-shaped ground, lane entrances and the civic palace create an inward focus.
plan_text: 弧形边缘与多处街巷入口让地面成为一个明确的城市房间。Nolli图中的公共地面与建筑内部应按原图的研究定义阅读。
Curved edges and multiple lane entrances make a legible civic room. Public ground and interiors in the Nolli drawing follow the author’s research definitions.
section_title: 剖面：坡面朝市政宫汇聚
Section: the ground converges toward the palace

text: 原研究剖面清楚显示：地面并非水平，市政宫位于视觉低侧。坡面把观看、坐卧和城市仪式组织在同一场地中。
The published section shows a non-level ground and the palace at the visual low side. The slope brings viewing, informal sitting and civic ritual into one space.

syntax_lede: 狭窄入口突然打开为宽阔坡面，是Campo最鲜明的步行体验。
Narrow entrances suddenly opening to the broad slope define Campo’s walking experience.

label: 原研究：入口与空间体验
Published study: entrances and spatial experience

boundary_lede: 连续街墙提供整体围合，市政宫与塔楼提供重点；统一不等于完全相同。
Continuous fronts provide enclosure; palace and tower provide focus. Coherence does not require uniformity.
boundary_text: 边界包含不同材料、开间与年代的建筑。整体空间秩序来自连续界面与共同地面，不是把每栋建筑画成同一种立面。
Edges include different materials, bays and periods. Continuous fronts and shared ground create coherence, not identical individual facades.
environment_lede: 内陆丘陵气候、开敞砖地与建筑阴影决定使用条件；树木不是核心广场的主要围合元素。
Inland hill climate, exposed brick ground and building shade shape use; trees are not the core square’s enclosing device.
life_lede: 普通日的坡面是穿行、短坐、交谈与观看建筑的共同地面。
On ordinary days, the slope supports passage, short stays, conversation and views of architecture.
event_lede: Palio不是普通周末的放大版：赛道、围栏、看台和入口控制改变了整个使用方式。
Palio is not simply a busier weekend: track, barriers, grandstands and controlled entries change how the ground works.
conclusion_lede: 最鲜明的价值在于坡地、街巷与社区仪式的共同作用，而不只是壳形轮廓。
Its defining value lies in slope, lanes and civic ritual acting together, beyond the shell-shaped outline.
conclusion_limit: 主要限制：坡地不等于普遍无障碍，夏季遮阴有限，赛事时自由通行受到明显限制。
Principal limitations: slope is not universal accessibility, summer shade is limited, and events restrict free passage.
